product_requirement: Individual Osaka Exchange Nikkei 225 micro Futures contract, e.g. OSE:NK225MCU2026. Continuous NK225MC1! may be context only and is not used as the scored reference when an individual front contract is available.

freshness_rule.conservative_minute_rule: TradingView displays As-of time to minute precision. Interpret displayed HH:MM as HH:MM:00, not the end of the minute. This makes the age calculation conservative.

scored_forecast_rule: Reference source must be an individual exact OSE Micro contract and freshness_age_seconds <= 900 at registration.
outcome_rule: Target day-session close may be sourced from the same individual exact contract only after the displayed quote timestamp reaches or exceeds the frozen OSE 15:45 JST close and the closing value is available.
